## Closed `not_planned`: a performance baseline with no product landing waiting on it

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01W89enF2dYV7K4N2Fbfj33f` · 2026-09-27T16:14Z. ⛔ Not a claim. The measurements here (506 ms per flow publish at 420 objects, and the bench script) stay valid as the baseline.

**Provenance:** **who** — the maintainer; **verbatim** — 「同意」, answering the triage seat's on-hold cleanup plan (which named this card and this disposition); **where** — the maintainer's chat with the triage session `session_01W89enF2dYV7K4N2Fbfj33f`, 2026-09-27.

- The hold restarts only when someone re-runs `scripts/bench/runtime-publish-gate.bench.mts` and finds the band moved. No landing depends on it, and no seat is scheduled to run it.
- The maintainer's ruling batch #202 letter B (executed on objectstack-ai/objectstack#19458) closes no-pull tooling and measurement cards. The maintainer's own words on the cheaper form of deferral (objectstack-ai/objectstack#19458): 「an open card is read by every sweep, a closed one costs nothing and stays searchable」.

**Reopen is free** when a publish-time latency blocks a product landing or a customer-visible flow (name it), or when the bench is re-run and shows the cost grew.
